700290101.text: How did it go, Traveler? Did Pursina's Spikes come in handy?

700290104.text: Very good! We did not labor in vain, then. I suppose this commission has also drawn to a close.

700290105.text: As for this anomalous Ruin Grader model, its functions seem vastly different from your ordinary wandering Ruin Guards or Ruin Hunters. The entire thought process behind their design was superior by leaps and bounds.

700290106.text: However, similar machines are not common. My guess is that this might have been some sort of experimental model.

700290107.text: Why did its initial creator make it in the first place?

700290108.text: Does this mean that the ancients' skill in making autonomous machines is greater than we estimated? How very fascinating.

700290109.text: If I could take it apart, we'd be sure to make some revolutionary discoveries...

700290110.text: Traveler, if you have the time, could you take me to see the remains of that anomalous model?

700290111.text: There's not much left of it.

700290112.text: What? Did you destroy its frame completely?

700290113.text: Agh, Archon... What a colossal waste! No, it's a colossal error!

700290114.text: *sigh* It's all my fault. I should have reminded you beforehand...

700290115.text: Ah, what a shame, what a shame! It could have been a historical find in the field of ancient technical studies... And now there's nothing left to even take back as samples.
